tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250byang gter rdo rje phur pa dril sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs so// 1$0000300na moḥshrī badzra ku mā ra ye/ 'khor 'das kun khyab chos sku kun tu bzang*/ kha sbyor bdun ldan longs sku rdo rje sems// gang 'dul der sprul gsang bdag smug nag yum// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// tshangs pa gdong gsum lha dbang klu'i rig 'dzin// rgyal po dza dang shākya pra bha'i zhabs// grub pa'i dbang phyug padmāka ra la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// bi ma mi tra shī la mañdzu dang*// mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rdo rje bdud 'joms rje// zab gter sgo 'byed dngos grub rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// sku yi sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po dang*// rigs sngags 'chang ba rdo rje mgon po'i zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// thugs sras chen po sngags 'chang drang so ba// legs ldan zhabs dang chos rgyal dbang po'i sde// ngag gi dbang po rig 'dzin yol mo bar// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// mthu stobs dbang phyug chos dbyings rang grol rje// grangs med rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs bshes gnyen mchog /kun mkhyen ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// ring nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa lhag pa'i lha// phrin las rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid he ru ka /rdo rje gzhon nus rjes bzung rig 'dzin rjer// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// sangs rgyas byams bzang se ston nyi ma bzang*// mgon po rin chen rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*// spyan tshab mnyam med chos rgyal dbang po'i sder// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po dang*// stobs ldan dpa' bo zur chen padma dbang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma bla med rdo rje rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol/

❀ kha skong*/ ris med yongs 'dzin du ma'i thugs kyi sras// gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i grub mchog rje// lha btsun chen po padma phrin las la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// theg chog rdo rje snying po'i ba gam rtser// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs cur sgreng mdzad pa'i// rigs bdag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phung po gcig bsdus pa'i// padmāka ra'i rgyal tshab dam pa mchog /rig 'dzin skal bzang padma dbang phyug la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// dam pa'i rjes bzung mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /grub pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /khyab bdag bla ma padma mi tra la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// bslab gsum sdom brtson 'dzin pa'i ded dpon mchog /snga 'gyur bstan pa spel mdzad chos kyi rje// 'khor lo'i mgon po padma ngag dbang la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// theg mchog rdo rje snying po'i bcud mchog kun// zab mo thugs kyi bum par legs gtams shing*// spel mkhas kun bzang gsang sngags bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// zung 'jug 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i don// ma nor ji bzhin ston mdzad chos kyi rje// padma'i thugs sras nam mkha' klong yangs la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// snying po'i don gzigs mdo sngags chos kyi mtho// gu ru'i lung thob padma dbang rgyal dang*// mkhas grub kun gtso skal bzang bdud 'dul la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// bslab gsum rnam dag sdom gsum khrims kyis mdzes// rgyal ba'i myu gu mnyam nyid rdo rje dang// rdo rje 'dzin pa theg mchog bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// snang srid dag pa chos sku'i klong du gzigs// ma 'dres kha dog rtags kyis legs 'khyud pa'i// drin can sprul sku rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol/

❀ /phung khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i lus// gsang gsum lha yi 'khor lor lhun grub pa'i// 'phrin las phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// lho brag dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i gsang sgo'i nang*// mi phyed rgyas btab zab gter yid bzhin nor// dam can gter skyong srung mar bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// 'di phyi rnam kun byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma mchog dang lhag pa'i lhar bcas pas// rjes su bzung nas gsang chen snying po'i lam// rim gnyis zab don nyams su longs par shog /mtshan ma'i phur bus dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing*// don gyi phur bus ma rig rtog 'dzin bsgral// lhun grub dbyings rig 'od gsal phyam gcig gzhir// yongs dag sku gsum 'bras bu lhun grub shog / ces pa 'di yang rigs sngags 'chang ba dge slong padma phrin las kyis rang gi ngag 'don phyir phur sgrub kyi thun mtshams su 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni don ldan no/ ༈ /gter mdzod brgyud 'debs ltar na/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che'i mtshams su/ ris med yongs 'dzin du ma'i thugs kyi sras// gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i grub mchog rje// lha btsun chen po padma phrin las la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// rig pa 'dzin mchog padma dbang rgyal dang*// rdo rje thogs med 'gyur med blo ldan dang*// padma bshes gnyen phrin las lhun gyis grub// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// o rgyan rang grol rdo rje phrin las dar// nges don bstan 'phel bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs// tshe dbang rig 'dzin thub bstan rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// nye brgyud bka' babs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// rgyal kun phrin las rjes skyong gu ṇa'i zhabs// phrin las mchog grub rdo rje dbang mchog rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// 'jam pa'i rdo rje chos kyi blo gros zhabs// phur pa'i grub brnyes rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so mthu dbang grub gnyis stsol// phung khams rnam par dag pa
sogs brgyud 'debs dkyus ltar ro// ces pa'ang dad mos kyi blos rnying sngags rgan po mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis dad pas bris pa'o/// /
